name: Notched Cowpea
desc: Notched Cowpea (Vigna marina): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vigna marina is a prostrate, creeping vine and a perennial plant. Also known as the beach pea, nanea, and notched cowpea, it is a species of legume in the family Fabaceae.
